title: Finishing the method book, Piron, Albert-system clarinet and Boehm
summary: He went through a whole method with Tio, finished with Piron when Tio fell ill at about 19, and recalls Albert-system keys and later switching to Boehm in the Navy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
